# markdown

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:markdown`](gmeow-markdown.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/markdown>
- **Category:** datatype
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/kernel`](../../slices/kernel.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The CommonMark literal datatype — documentation content carried in the graph is CommonMark, typed with this datatype so the convention is machine-visible. Used ONLY in annotation literals (scope notes, examples, guide content), never in logical axioms, so the OWL 2 DL profile is untouched. HTML or SGML subsets are explicitly rejected: one markup convention, visible in the data.

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:markdown`](gmeow-markdown.md) when the definition matches the source fact. Prefer a narrower GMEOW term when one exists, and keep projection concerns in the mapping layer.
